ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant high-intensity (white/light-grey) central region encompassing approximately 85% of the surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (black/dark-grey) peripheral boundaries and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity pixels. Low-intensity pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and appear as discrete, non-contiguous linear streaks and focal spots (mottling) concentrated primarily in the lower-central region near the notch and across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks increases distally, with the right lobe showing more pronounced, jagged pixel-variance compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature (inward sweep) along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp, upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, high-contrast, multi-tonal (beige/brown/grey) textured clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, low-intensity linear disruptions (scratches) mapped across both lobes; notably, three parallel diagonal lines on the mid-left lobe and multiple intersecting dark lines on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on both fluke tips; multiple dark rake-mark scars across the ventral surface; irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting previous tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of extreme terminal barnacle clusters and the specific intersecting rake mark pattern on the right lobe provides a unique spatial identifier.
